consultations.verdict: Support (weak): NbVO5 near-stable (0.027 eV/atom), MEGNet HSE gap 3.48 eV marginal vs 3.22 eV photons; V-rich side should absorb more (V5+ lowers gap), so start at the most V-rich end, index 7.
Support (exploratory): Nb4VO12-type Nb-rich phase predicted HSE gap 2.84 eV, below the 3.22 eV photon energy, so the Nb-rich end may absorb; measure index 9 to bracket the composition line.
